classification.difficultyReason: Determine the scale factor by substituting a supplied point, then combine the resulting equation, three simple roots, y-intercept and leading-term direction in a cubic sketch; part (a) supports part (b).

content.prompt: The cubic function is defined as $f(x)=k(x-1)(x+3)(x-4)$.

children.label: b
children.prompt: Write down the full equation of the cubic and sketch its graph.

answer.worked: Substituting $k=2$ gives $f(x)=2(x-1)(x+3)(x-4)$. The factors give $x$-intercepts $(-3,0)$, $(1,0)$ and $(4,0)$. The given value $f(0)=24$ gives the $y$-intercept $(0,24)$. Each root is simple, so the graph crosses the $x$-axis at each one. Its positive leading coefficient gives a downward left end and an upward right end.

spec.description: Cubic with three labelled x-intercepts and labelled y-intercept. No numerical tick scale or grid. Standard blue replaces the source blue curve.
